datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: IPC acute food insecurity phase classifications were collected by FEWS NET field enumerators on a regular schedule (approximately quarterly) and spatially delineated as geographic polygons at sub-national level. The medium-term projection scenario represents projected food security conditions for Djibouti across four time points in 2012, distributed as GeoJSON files.
